thread:
Maya: quick follow-up from the all-hands on billing/quotas — short Qs about CI/staging, retries, and exemptions.

Eli: which specific items?

Maya: 1) are CI/staging runs billed to org credits by default? 2) do automatic retries incur token charges per attempt? 3) can internal test jobs be exempted from monthly quotas?

Sam: answers: 1) yes unless using infra-scoped keys or the internal invocation flag. 2) retries are new requests and count tokens each time. 3) yes, but only via an ops whitelist (file a ticket with job names and volumes).

June: ops process: submit ticket with org_id, job names, owner, and expected monthly tokens. We review and add a limited whitelist. No blanket org exemptions.

Maya: noted. Eli — can you add a short docs blurb and an ops ticket template?

Eli: will do, ETA EOW.
